summary: Cowork-team daily document redesign v2 — 5 PO additions integrated: (1) cron-exclusive MARKET channel with 30s danger-drain lane, (2) full-at-milestone / delta-intraday fingerprint dedup, (3) watch/attention register (docs/attention/watch.md) for forward-looking catalysts, (4) retention lifecycle with roll-up-before-prune invariant and tunable windows, (5) one-time migration recap-then-clean before legacy signal deprecation. 29 F-items + 4 F-MIG items. All v1 decisions intact except OVERRIDE of direct market send by alert-commander (now danger-drain lane).
v1_overrides: Design Point C: alert-commander no longer calls send_telegram(channel=market) directly — replaced by 30s danger-drain lane in delivery cron
Postman section: renamed to delivery cron; two-lane (30s danger + 5min normal); SOLE market sender
new_additions: Addition 1: Delivery channel exclusivity — no cowork agent sends to market; agents keep direct send for work/bug
Addition 2: push_mode full|delta; market-push-state.json fingerprint; unchanged intraday tick = no push
Addition 3: Watch/Attention Register — docs/attention/watch.md; per-agent ## WATCH subsection; CHEF consolidates; 8-field item schema; lifecycle open→triggered→resolved|expired
Addition 4: Retention lifecycle — roll-up-before-prune; defaults daily=14d weekly=8w monthly=24m yearly=indefinite; digest-predict prune runner; fail-safe verify-before-delete
Addition 5: One-time migration recap F-MIG1–F-MIG4 gated before P3.7 legacy cleanup
phase_sequence: Phase 1 (F1-F8): Foundation — dirs, gitignore, caps, schedule stubs, spec, watch.md, push-state.json
Phase 2 (F9-F17): Parallel run — header write + agents append to daily folder with ## WATCH subsections, existing delivery unchanged

Phase 3 (F18-F29 + F-MIG1-F-MIG4): Full cutover — delta-read, delivery cron (2 lanes), outbox cutover, watch consolidation, CHEF reads daily folder, migration recap-then-clean, retention prune wired into digest-predict
first_action: F1: Create directory structure (docs/daily/, docs/outbox/market/danger|normal|dead, docs/recaps/*, docs/attention/) and update .gitignore
qa_gates: Phase 2 gate: 5 consecutive trading days — ## WATCH subsections present, no cycle-time regression — PO sign-off required before Phase 3
Phase 3 gate: 10 consecutive trading days — danger lane ≤30s, dedup confirmed, watch register surfacing items in dishes, retention prune cycle verified — user verbal confirmation
new_components: delivery-cron (NOT an agent — cron process, two lanes)
